title: chant ci list output
description: What `chant ci list --json` prints (#4021, ws-103): the first-parent commits of the branch ci.green names, newest first, within ci.green.window or after --since, each with its state from the ci/green/<sha> and ci/revoked/<sha> tags and the result of each required phase. It reads local refs and tags and never fetches; with --forge it also reads check runs for the commits that have no ci tag. With the source chant runs (ci.green.source or --source runs, #4044) it reads the signed Op runs on the local chant/lifecycle for those commits instead, and refuses --forge. Version 1 of the read contract. Readers ignore fields they do not know; a field is only ever added within a version, so a later release may add more fields to each commit. `work` says whether the commit names its work item; it was added by #4029. The codes are a closed list, each in the one closed list of `reason-codes.ts`. Contract version 1 of this document is written by chant 0.124.28 and newer; the read contract as a whole by chant 0.81.0 and newer.

result.description: Exit code 0, with or without commits.

root.description: The workspace root relative to the git root, with / separators, "." for the git root itself.

ref.description: The ref whose first-parent commits were walked: refs/remotes/origin/<branch> when the checkout has it, else refs/heads/<branch>.

window.description: ci.green.window, or null when --since replaced it.

since.description: The revision --since named; the commits listed come after it. Null when it was not given.

require.description: ci.green.require: the phases a commit must pass, in order. Each commit's phases list them in the same order.

committed.description: The commit's committer time, ISO 8601, UTC.

state.description: revoked when the commit has a revoked tag, else green when it has a green tag, else undecided.

green.description: The commit's green tag, or null.

tagged.description: When the tag was made, ISO 8601, or null for a lightweight tag.

signer.description: Added within contract version 1 by #4031, written by chant 0.124.28 and newer. The runner principal whose statement the tag carries, or null when it counts unsigned: ci.green.signedSince is not set, or the commit is a strict first-parent ancestor of it.

revoked.description: The commit's revoked tag, or null.

tagged.description: When the tag was made, ISO 8601, or null for a lightweight tag.

phase.description: The phase the annotation names as failed, or null when the annotation can't be read.

env.description: The env the run is recorded under.

signer.description: The runner principal whose statement the run carries.

opRun.description: Added within contract version 1 by #4044, written by chant 0.124.28 and newer. Present only when the run is a chant Op run (ci.green.source runs): name is then the Op's name and id is null. Absent for a check run.

run.description: The run the annotation names as failed.

signer.description: Added within contract version 1 by #4031, written by chant 0.124.28 and newer. The runner principal whose statement the tag carries, or null when it counts unsigned: ci.green.signedSince is not set, or the commit is a strict first-parent ancestor of it.

result.description: pass and fail come from the tags (a green tag records the phases that passed, a revoked tag the one that failed) or, for an undecided commit, from the forge under --forge, or from the signed Op runs on the local chant/lifecycle when the source is chant runs (#4044). pending is such a read with runs still going or not yet reported. unrecorded means no tag holds the result and nothing was read.

env.description: The env the run is recorded under.

signer.description: The runner principal whose statement the run carries.

opRun.description: Added within contract version 1 by #4044, written by chant 0.124.28 and newer. Present only when the run is a chant Op run (ci.green.source runs): name is then the Op's name and id is null. Absent for a check run.

runs.description: The check runs behind the result: those the green tag recorded, the failed run a revoked tag names, or those the forge returned. Empty when unrecorded.

work.description: Whether the commit names the work item it belongs to (#4029), by the definition `workspace check --changes` uses: a Chant-Record trailer of a work kind the declaration names whose record exists, or a Chant-Lease trailer that resolves to a work item. The records are read at `ref`. A window match does not count. Null when the checkout is not in a workspace that declares a work kind, or the kinds can't be read. Added within contract version 1, and written by chant 0.124.28 and newer; a reader that finds no `work` is reading an older chant, and one that finds null has been told nothing. A commit that is unlinked or wrong is why its work item is unknown.

state.description: linked: a trailer names a work record that exists, or a lease that resolves to one (a lease is taken as linked when this checkout has no chant/lifecycle branch to read). unlinked: no Chant-Record or Chant-Lease trailer names anything. wrong: trailers name a work item but none of them is one that exists. merge: a merge commit, whose work is the commits it brings.

ids.description: The work records the trailers name, as <kind>:<id>. Empty unless state is linked.

problems.description: The trailers that do not link the commit. Empty unless state is wrong.

ignored.description: Added within contract version 1 by #4031, written by chant 0.124.28 and newer. The commit's ci tags that do not count for want of a valid statement signed by a runner key. A tag on any commit that is not a strict first-parent ancestor of ci.green.signedSince needs one; empty when signedSince is not set. state, green and revoked count only the tags that are not ignored.

status.description: unsigned: the annotation carries no statement. invalid: the statement is not a ci-tag statement, or names another signer than the key's. untrusted: no runner key .chant/trust.json lists at base signed it, or its principal holds no runner role. mismatch: it signs another commit, tag kind or branch, the annotation's record is not the one signed, or the tag points at another commit than its name gives.

ignoredRuns.description: Added within contract version 1 by #4044, written by chant 0.124.28 and newer. Present only when the source is chant runs (ci.green.source or --source runs): the Op runs on the commit that do not count for want of a valid statement signed by a runner key whose principal holds the runner role. They neither green nor revoke the commit.

status.description: unsigned: the record carries no statement. invalid: the statement is not an op-run statement, or names another signer than the key's. untrusted: no runner key .chant/trust.json lists at base signed it, or its principal holds no runner role. mismatch: it signs another run, commit or record than the ledger holds.
